entry.title: New: Bill 57, FD1 (2025) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND CHAPTER 3.34, MAUI COUNTY CODE, TO ESTABLISH A VOLUNTARY DEED RESTRICTION PROGRAM" The purpose of this bill is to enable open-market homes to be converted to deed-restricted properties, preserving the properties for local residents and workforce while addressing the growing housing challenges in Maui County.

View on the council site
